description: Source code for a plugin module implementing MySQL/MariaDB backend for virtual host mapping in the lighttpd web server.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_dbconf_free
methods.description: Frees the database connection configuration, closing the MySQL connection and freeing memory.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_dbconf_setup
methods.description: Sets up the database connection configuration based on provided options, establishing a MySQL connection.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_patch_config
methods.description: Applies plugin configuration patches to a request.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_mysql_query
methods.description: Executes a MySQL query to retrieve the virtual host's document root based on the domain.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_init
methods.description: Initializes the MySQL vhost database backend plugin.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up plugin resources, freeing database configurations.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges a single plugin configuration value into the current plugin config.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_merge_config
methods.description: Merges multiple plugin configuration values into the current plugin config.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_patch_config
methods.description: Patches the plugin configuration for a specific request.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_mysql_plugin_init
methods.description: Registers the plugin with the server, setting version, name, and lifecycle functions.
